summary: The Big Data Platform Engineer builds, maintains, and optimizes enterprise-scale big data platforms for analytics, AI, and operational workloads.
responsibilities: Architect and deploy scalable big data platforms (on-premise, cloud, or hybrid)
Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and performance
Maintain data ingestion, processing, and storage pipelines
Implement monitoring, alerting, and automation for platform operations
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and DevOps teams

education: 6–10 years of experience in big data platform engineering
Data Warehousing & Analytics Engineering – Detailed Job Descriptions

skills_required.name: Deep knowledge of Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and cloud platforms
Strong programming and system design skills
Experience with data governance, security, and compliance
Familiarity with platform automation and DevOps tools
